The failing test `test_get_level_values_when_periods` checks whether the levels of a `MultiIndex` object are sorted in monotonic increasing order after being retrieved using `.get_level_values()`. However, the error occurred because one or more levels returned `None`, as indicated by the traceback showing an attempt to access `.view()` on `None`.

Upon examining the code snippet for `pandas.core.indexes.multi.MultiIndex.is_monotonic_increasing()`, we see that it first checks if all levels are monotonic increasing using a generator expression. If this check passes, it proceeds with lexsort operation on the codes directly (lines 1435-1437). However, in our case, since one or more levels returned `None`, the generator expression raised an AttributeError before reaching this section of code.

The error likely occurs during the creation of `idx2` using `.from_arrays()`. One of the levels generated by `[idx._get_level_values(level) for level in range(idx.nlevels)]` returned `None`, leading to the eventual assertion failure and the encountered error.

Conclusion: The test `pandas.tests.indexes.multi.test_get_level_values.test_get_level_values_when_periods()` failed due to a generator expression raising an AttributeError during the creation of `idx2`. This occurred because one or more levels returned `None` while trying to access `.get_level_values()`.
